description: By Stephanie Walsh | GilbertOPINION — We are at a critical moment in Arizona. We face reduced water allocations, rising costs, and rapid advances in artificial intelligence. How we respond to these challenges will shape the future of our state and the opportunities available to our children. We can’t continue to kick those cans down the road.With our busy lives, it's easy to tune out elections. I've heard the questions: Aren’t all candidates the same? Do I just vote by party?
